integrity: The proof is complete within stated assumptions, exact equality and component-count conditions follow from Fourier orthogonality and a Toeplitz rank argument. Numerical tests are supplemental, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite positive independently weighted mixtures of complete primitive closed geodesics on the standard flat two-torus, exact square-band Parseval energy, and physical traversed arclength. It makes no claim about general curves, connectors, or approximately tight frames. Some recent specialist full texts were not accessible; historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Rigidity and sharp arclength of positive multi-direction geodesic Fourier designs on the flat torus
